summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K containing routine monthly updates: a total voting rights update, and several Director/PDMR shareholding notifications under the Market Abuse Regulation. The voting rights update provides the share count for determining notification thresholds. The PDMR transactions include a Share Incentive Plan purchase by CFO Andy Agg and an ADS purchase by Chair Paula Rosput Reynolds. No transaction terms beyond price and volume are material. This is a standard reporting filing with no event constituting a special situation.
